name: phenol
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of occasional minor irritation, pain, sore mouth and sore throat.
otcwarn: Warnings Sore Throat Warning: Severe or persistent sore throat or sore throat accompanied by high fever, headache, nausea, and vomiting may be serious. Consult a doctor promptly. Do not use more than 2 days or give to children under 3 years of age unless directed by a doctor.
